notes: This file is the primary emergency copilot knowledge base.
Rules-first behavior must work even when the LLM is unavailable.
Critical scenarios must never depend on the model.

mustDo: Recommend 112 clearly when the case is severe.
Ask at most one follow-up question and only after critical steps.

locationMissingNote.ro: Chiar daca locatia lipseste, urmeaza pasii de mai jos acum. Daca poti, trimite apoi adresa exacta, etajul sau un reper clar.
locationMissingNote.en: Even without a location, follow the steps below now. If you can, then share the exact address, floor or a clear landmark.

locationUsefulNote.ro: Daca poti vorbi, spune imediat adresa exacta, etajul sau un reper usor de recunoscut.
locationUsefulNote.en: If you can speak, give the exact address, floor or a clear landmark right away.

fallbackQuestion.ro: Care este pericolul sau simptomul cel mai urgent chiar acum?
fallbackQuestion.en: What is the most urgent danger or symptom right now?

panicDeescalation.ro: Respira lent. Eu iti dau doar pasii importanti, pe rand.
panicDeescalation.en: Breathe slowly. I will give only the important steps, one by one.

high.responseGoal: immediate stabilization and escalate if red flags appear

nonEmergencyIndicators: ce trebuie sa am in kit

no_location.ro: Fara locatie pot oferi pasii de baza. Daca poti, trimite apoi adresa exacta sau un reper clar.
no_location.en: Without a location I can still give the core steps. If you can, then send the exact address or a clear landmark.

panicked_user.ro: Utilizatorul poate scrie haotic. Prioritizeaza pasii critici si reducerea panicii, fara text inutil.
panicked_user.en: The user may write chaotically. Prioritize critical steps and panic reduction, without extra filler.

incomplete_input.ro: Daca mesajul este prea scurt sau incomplet, da pasii de baza si o singura intrebare de clarificare.
incomplete_input.en: If the message is too short or incomplete, give the core steps and one clarifying question.

ambiguous_input.ro: Daca mesajul este ambiguu intre doua scenarii, alege scenariul mai sigur si mentioneaza doar pasii care nu cresc riscul.
ambiguous_input.en: If the message is ambiguous between two scenarios, choose the safer one and mention only steps that do not increase risk.

child_patient.ro: Daca este vorba despre copil sau sugar, creste prioritatea pentru respiratie, constienta, convulsii, ingestie toxica si febra cu stare alterata.
child_patient.en: If the patient is a child or infant, raise priority for breathing problems, consciousness changes, seizures, toxic ingestion and high fever with altered state.

elderly_patient.ro: Daca este vorba despre varstnic, trateaza mai serios caderea, confuzia brusca, respiratia grea, durerea in piept si lipsa de raspuns.
elderly_patient.en: If the patient is elderly, treat falls, sudden confusion, breathing difficulty, chest pain and unresponsiveness as higher risk.

messy_short_input.ro: Pentru input-uri foarte scurte sau cu typo-uri, foloseste routing-ul pe cuvinte de risc si raspuns sigur minim fara sa astepti context perfect.
messy_short_input.en: For very short or typo-heavy inputs, use risk-word routing and give the safest minimal response without waiting for perfect context.

multiple_victims.ro: Daca sunt mentionate mai multe persoane, prioritizeaza pericolul vital imediat si cere doar o singura clarificare despre cine este in risc maxim.
multiple_victims.en: If multiple people are mentioned, prioritize immediate life threats and ask only one clarification about who is at highest risk.

ro.summary: Prioritatea este evacuarea rapida si evitarea fumului.
followUpQuestions: Esti inca in locuinta sau ai iesit deja afara?

immediateSteps.title: Iesi imediat daca traseul este sigur
immediateSteps.detail: Paraseste locuinta pe cea mai scurta cale libera.

immediateSteps.title: Stai jos daca este fum
immediateSteps.detail: Mergi aplecat sau taras pentru a reduce inhalarea de fum.

immediateSteps.title: Nu folosi liftul
immediateSteps.detail: Foloseste doar scarile, daca sunt practicabile si sigure.

immediateSteps.title: Inchide usile in urma ta daca poti
immediateSteps.detail: Asta poate incetini raspandirea focului si a fumului.

donts: Nu te intoarce dupa obiecte personale.
Nu deschide o usa fierbinte cu mana goala.
Nu pierde timp cautand sursa exacta a focului daca evacuarea este posibila.

en.summary: The priority is quick evacuation and avoiding smoke.
followUpQuestions: Are you still inside the home or already outside?

immediateSteps.title: Leave immediately if the route is safe
immediateSteps.detail: Exit by the shortest clear route.

immediateSteps.title: Stay low if there is smoke
immediateSteps.detail: Move crouched or crawl to reduce smoke inhalation.

immediateSteps.title: Do not use the elevator
immediateSteps.detail: Use stairs only if they are usable and safe.

immediateSteps.title: Close doors behind you if you can
immediateSteps.detail: This may slow the spread of fire and smoke.

donts: Do not go back for personal items.
Do not open a hot door with a bare hand.
Do not waste time searching for the exact fire source if evacuation is possible.

ro.summary: Intr-o cladire inalta, prioritatea este evacuarea sigura sau izolarea daca iesirea este blocata.
followUpQuestions: E scara de evacuare libera sau iesirea este blocata de fum?

immediateSteps.title: Foloseste doar scarile daca sunt sigure
immediateSteps.detail: Paraseste cladirea daca ruta este libera de fum dens si caldura extrema.

immediateSteps.title: Nu folosi liftul
immediateSteps.detail: Liftul poate ramane blocat sau se poate deschide intr-o zona cu fum.

immediateSteps.title: Daca nu poti iesi, blocheaza patrunderea fumului
immediateSteps.detail: Inchide usa si etanseaza fantele cu textile umede daca ai la indemana.

immediateSteps.title: Fa-te vizibil pentru salvatori
immediateSteps.detail: Stai la geam, semnalizeaza si spune etajul exact la 112.

donts: Nu sari pe geam.
Nu folosi liftul nici daca pare functional.
Nu deschide usa daca pe sub ea intra fum fierbinte in cantitate mare.

en.summary: In a high-rise building, the priority is safe evacuation or sealing yourself in if the exit is blocked.
followUpQuestions: Is the stairwell clear, or is the exit blocked by smoke?

immediateSteps.title: Use stairs only if they are safe
immediateSteps.detail: Leave the building if the route is clear of dense smoke and extreme heat.

immediateSteps.title: Do not use the elevator
immediateSteps.detail: The elevator can fail or open into smoke.

immediateSteps.title: If you cannot leave, block smoke from entering
immediateSteps.detail: Close the door and seal gaps with wet fabric if available.

immediateSteps.title: Make yourself visible to rescuers
immediateSteps.detail: Stay by a window, signal for help and tell 112 your exact floor.

donts: Do not jump from a window.
Do not use the elevator even if it seems to work.
Do not open the door if hot smoke is pushing in underneath it.

ro.summary: La incendiu de vegetatie, prioritatea este sa te indepartezi de directia focului si sa eviti zonele cu fum dens.
followUpQuestions: Esti pe jos, cu masina sau intr-o locuinta aproape de foc?

immediateSteps.title: Pleaca imediat din directia focului si a vantului
immediateSteps.detail: Mergi spre o zona deschisa sau deja arsa, daca aceea este singura ruta sigura.

immediateSteps.title: Evita fumului dens
immediateSteps.detail: Acopera gura si nasul cu un material si tine-te cat mai jos daca fumul te inconjoara.

immediateSteps.title: Daca esti cu masina, nu conduce prin foc sau fum opac
immediateSteps.detail: Intoarce-te daca vizibilitatea devine aproape zero.

immediateSteps.title: Suna la 112 daca focul se apropie sau cineva este blocat
immediateSteps.detail: Spune zona, sensul de deplasare si orice reper util.

donts: Nu merge spre deal daca focul urca rapid pe versant.
Nu intra in fum opac fara o iesire clara.
Nu ramane sa fotografiezi sau sa observi focul.

en.summary: In a wildfire, the priority is moving away from the fire path and avoiding dense smoke.
followUpQuestions: Are you on foot, in a car, or inside a home near the fire?

immediateSteps.title: Move away from the direction of the fire and wind immediately
immediateSteps.detail: Go toward an open area or an already burned area if that is the only safe route.

immediateSteps.title: Avoid dense smoke
immediateSteps.detail: Cover your mouth and nose and stay lower if smoke surrounds you.

immediateSteps.title: If you are in a car, do not drive into fire or opaque smoke
immediateSteps.detail: Turn back if visibility drops close to zero.

immediateSteps.title: Call 112 if the fire is approaching or someone is trapped
immediateSteps.detail: Give the area, travel direction and any useful landmark.

donts: Do not move uphill toward a fast-rising fire.
Do not enter opaque smoke without a clear way out.
Do not stay to film or watch the fire.

ro.summary: In interior, prioritatea este sa te protejezi de obiectele care cad si sa nu fugi in timpul miscarii.
followUpQuestions: Cutremurul s-a oprit sau miscarea continua?

immediateSteps.title: Adaposteste-te imediat
immediateSteps.detail: Stai sub o masa solida sau langa un perete interior stabil.

immediateSteps.title: Protejeaza capul si gatul
immediateSteps.detail: Foloseste mainile, o geanta sau o perna daca este la indemana.

immediateSteps.title: Stai departe de geamuri si mobilier inalt
immediateSteps.detail: Cioburile si obiectele cazute sunt un risc imediat.

immediateSteps.title: Nu fugi pe scari in timpul miscarii
immediateSteps.detail: Muta-te doar dupa ce se opreste miscarea principala.

donts: Nu alerga spre iesire in timpul miscarii puternice.
Nu sta langa ferestre, oglinzi sau corpuri suspendate.
Nu folosi liftul dupa seism.

en.summary: Indoors, the priority is protecting yourself from falling objects and not running during the shaking.
followUpQuestions: Has the earthquake stopped, or is the shaking still happening?

immediateSteps.title: Take cover immediately
immediateSteps.detail: Get under a sturdy table or next to a solid interior wall.

immediateSteps.title: Protect your head and neck
immediateSteps.detail: Use your hands, a bag or a pillow if available.

immediateSteps.title: Stay away from windows and tall furniture
immediateSteps.detail: Broken glass and falling objects are an immediate hazard.

immediateSteps.title: Do not run to the stairs during the shaking
immediateSteps.detail: Move only after the main shaking stops.

donts: Do not run for the exit during strong shaking.
Do not stand near windows, mirrors or hanging fixtures.
Do not use the elevator after the quake.

ro.summary: In exterior, prioritatea este sa te indepartezi de cladiri, geamuri si cabluri.
followUpQuestions: Esti langa cladiri, stalpi sau intr-un spatiu deschis?

immediateSteps.title: Mergi spre un spatiu deschis daca poti fara sa cazi
immediateSteps.detail: Evita cladirile, fatadele, balcoanele si geamurile.

immediateSteps.title: Stai departe de cabluri si stalpi
immediateSteps.detail: Pot cadea sau pot deveni periculoase imediat dupa seism.

immediateSteps.title: Protejeaza-ti capul daca se desprind obiecte
immediateSteps.detail: Acopera capul si nu sta lipit de fatade.

donts: Nu sta langa cladiri inalte sau vitrine.
Nu intra intr-o cladire imediat dupa primul val daca nu este absolut necesar.

en.summary: Outdoors, the priority is moving away from buildings, glass and power lines.
followUpQuestions: Are you near buildings or poles, or already in an open area?

immediateSteps.title: Move toward an open area if you can do so without falling
immediateSteps.detail: Avoid buildings, facades, balconies and windows.

immediateSteps.title: Stay away from cables and poles
immediateSteps.detail: They can fall or become dangerous right after the quake.

immediateSteps.title: Protect your head if objects are falling
immediateSteps.detail: Cover your head and do not stand against a facade.

donts: Do not stand near tall buildings or storefront glass.
Do not go inside a building right after the first wave unless absolutely necessary.

ro.summary: In masina, prioritatea este sa opresti controlat si sa eviti podurile, tunelurile si cladirile.
followUpQuestions: Masina este deja oprita intr-o zona sigura?

immediateSteps.title: Opreste controlat intr-o zona cat mai deschisa
immediateSteps.detail: Evita podurile, pasajele, tunelurile, cladirile si copacii mari.

immediateSteps.title: Ramai in masina pana se opreste miscarea
immediateSteps.detail: Masina ofera protectie mai buna decat iesirea haotica in trafic.

immediateSteps.title: Pleaca doar dupa ce verifici daca drumul este sigur
immediateSteps.detail: Fii atent la fisuri, resturi, cabluri si alte pericole.

donts: Nu opri sub poduri sau langa cladiri.
Nu cobori in mijlocul traficului in timpul miscarii.

en.summary: In a car, the priority is controlled stopping and avoiding bridges, tunnels and buildings.
followUpQuestions: Is the car already stopped in a safe area?

immediateSteps.title: Stop in as open an area as possible
immediateSteps.detail: Avoid bridges, overpasses, tunnels, buildings and large trees.

immediateSteps.title: Stay in the car until the shaking stops
immediateSteps.detail: The car usually protects you better than a chaotic exit into traffic.

immediateSteps.title: Drive only after checking that the road is safe
immediateSteps.detail: Watch for cracks, debris, cables and other hazards.

donts: Do not stop under bridges or next to buildings.
Do not step out into traffic during the shaking.

ro.summary: Aceasta poate fi o urgenta medicala severa.
followUpQuestions: Persoana poate vorbi in propozitii scurte sau abia scoate sunete?

immediateSteps.title: Suna imediat la 112
immediateSteps.detail: Spune clar ca exista dificultati de respiratie sau sufocare.

immediateSteps.title: Pune persoana in pozitie semisezand
immediateSteps.detail: Nu o intinde complet daca respiratia se agraveaza culcat.

immediateSteps.title: Slabeste hainele stramte si asigura aer
immediateSteps.detail: Deschide geamul sau muta persoana intr-un loc cu aer mai bun daca este sigur.

immediateSteps.title: Monitorizeaza continuu daca respira
immediateSteps.detail: Daca respiratia se opreste, urmeaza imediat instructiunile dispecerului.

donts: Nu forta persoana sa mearga daca respiratia este grea.
Nu da mancare sau bautura in timp ce se sufoca sau abia respira.

en.summary: This may be a severe medical emergency.
followUpQuestions: Can the person speak in short sentences, or can they barely make sounds?

immediateSteps.title: Call 112 immediately
immediateSteps.detail: Say clearly that there is breathing difficulty or choking.

immediateSteps.title: Place the person in a semi-seated position
immediateSteps.detail: Do not lay them flat if breathing gets worse when lying down.

immediateSteps.title: Loosen tight clothing and ensure better air
immediateSteps.detail: Open a window or move the person to fresher air if safe.

immediateSteps.title: Monitor breathing continuously
immediateSteps.detail: If breathing stops, follow the dispatcher instructions immediately.

donts: Do not force the person to walk if breathing is hard.
Do not give food or drink while they are choking or barely breathing.

ro.summary: Aceasta poate fi o urgenta vitala imediata.
followUpQuestions: Persoana raspunde sau respira normal in acest moment?

immediateSteps.title: Suna la 112 imediat
immediateSteps.detail: Spune ca persoana nu raspunde sau nu respira normal.

immediateSteps.title: Verifica rapid daca raspunde si daca respira normal
immediateSteps.detail: Priveste miscarea toracelui si incearca un stimul verbal scurt.

immediateSteps.title: Daca nu respira normal, incepe compresiile toracice
immediateSteps.detail: Urmeaza instructiunile dispecerului pana vine echipajul.

immediateSteps.title: Cere unui martor sa aduca un defibrilator daca exista
immediateSteps.detail: Continua compresiile pana cand ai instructiuni sa te opresti.

donts: Nu astepta sa isi revina singur daca nu raspunde.
Nu intrerupe compresiile fara motiv serios.

en.summary: This may be an immediate life-threatening emergency.
followUpQuestions: Is the person responding or breathing normally right now?

immediateSteps.title: Call 112 immediately
immediateSteps.detail: Say the person is unresponsive or not breathing normally.

immediateSteps.title: Quickly check responsiveness and normal breathing
immediateSteps.detail: Look for chest movement and try a short verbal stimulus.

immediateSteps.title: If they are not breathing normally, start chest compressions
immediateSteps.detail: Follow the dispatcher instructions until help arrives.

immediateSteps.title: Ask someone to bring an AED if one is available
immediateSteps.detail: Keep compressions going until told to stop.

donts: Do not wait for the person to recover on their own if they do not respond.
Do not stop compressions without a serious reason.

ro.summary: Poate fi un atac de panica, dar trebuie urmarite semnele care il fac diferit de un atac de cord.
followUpQuestions: Exista durere puternica in piept, transpiratii reci sau durere care merge in brat ori maxilar?

immediateSteps.title: Opreste activitatea si aseaza persoana
immediateSteps.detail: Mut-o intr-un loc sigur si fara aglomeratie daca este posibil.

immediateSteps.title: Ghideaza respiratia lent
immediateSteps.detail: Inspira lent pe nas si expira lent pe gura, fara fortare.

immediateSteps.title: Verifica semnele de alarma cardiaca
immediateSteps.detail: Durerea intensa in piept, lesinul, slabiciunea extrema sau iradierea durerii cer evaluare urgenta.

donts: Nu spune persoanei sa se calmeze agresiv.
Nu presupune automat ca este doar anxietate daca exista durere severa in piept.

en.summary: This may be a panic attack, but you must check for warning signs that make it different from a heart attack.
followUpQuestions: Is there strong chest pain, cold sweating, or pain spreading to the arm or jaw?

immediateSteps.title: Stop activity and seat the person
immediateSteps.detail: Move them to a safer, less crowded place if possible.

immediateSteps.title: Guide slow breathing
immediateSteps.detail: Breathe in slowly through the nose and out slowly through the mouth, without forcing it.

immediateSteps.title: Check for cardiac red flags
immediateSteps.detail: Severe chest pain, fainting, extreme weakness or pain spreading outward require urgent escalation.

donts: Do not tell the person to calm down aggressively.
Do not assume it is only anxiety if there is severe chest pain.

ro.summary: Semnele pot indica un posibil infarct. Prioritatea este apelul rapid la 112 si limitarea efortului.
followUpQuestions: Durerea este puternica, apasatoare si merge spre brat, spate sau maxilar?

immediateSteps.title: Suna la 112 imediat
immediateSteps.detail: Spune clar ca suspectezi un atac de cord.

immediateSteps.title: Aseaza persoana si opreste orice efort
immediateSteps.detail: Pozitia semisezand este de obicei mai confortabila.

immediateSteps.title: Monitorizeaza starea si respiratia
immediateSteps.detail: Daca persoana nu mai raspunde sau nu respira normal, urmeaza instructiunile dispecerului.

donts: Nu lasa persoana sa conduca singura la spital.
Nu minimiza durerea daca apare transpiratie rece, greata sau slabiciune intensa.

en.summary: The signs may suggest a heart attack. The priority is a fast 112 call and stopping exertion.
followUpQuestions: Is the pain strong, heavy or crushing, and does it spread to the arm, back or jaw?

immediateSteps.title: Call 112 immediately
immediateSteps.detail: Say clearly that you suspect a heart attack.

immediateSteps.title: Seat the person and stop all exertion
immediateSteps.detail: A semi-seated position is often more comfortable.

immediateSteps.title: Monitor condition and breathing
immediateSteps.detail: If the person becomes unresponsive or stops breathing normally, follow dispatcher instructions immediately.

donts: Do not let the person drive themselves to the hospital.
Do not minimize the pain if there is cold sweating, nausea or extreme weakness.
call112Triggers: pain spreading to arm or jaw

ro.summary: La lesin, prioritatea este sa verifici respiratia si sa previi o noua cadere.
followUpQuestions: Persoana si-a revenit complet sau ramane confuza?

immediateSteps.title: Verifica daca respira si raspunde
immediateSteps.detail: Daca nu raspunde sau nu respira normal, suna la 112.

immediateSteps.title: Aseaza persoana in siguranta pe podea
immediateSteps.detail: Ridica usor picioarele daca nu exista suspiciune de traumatism grav.

immediateSteps.title: Dupa revenire, ridicarea trebuie sa fie lenta
immediateSteps.detail: Nu o lasa sa se ridice brusc.

donts: Nu da lichide imediat daca persoana este inca confuza sau somnolenta.
Nu ignora o lovitura la cap dupa lesin.

en.summary: With fainting, the priority is checking breathing and preventing another fall.
followUpQuestions: Has the person fully recovered, or are they still confused?

immediateSteps.title: Check whether the person is breathing and responding
immediateSteps.detail: If they do not respond or are not breathing normally, call 112.

immediateSteps.title: Place the person safely on the floor
immediateSteps.detail: Raise the legs slightly only if there is no suspicion of major trauma.

immediateSteps.title: After recovery, help them rise slowly
immediateSteps.detail: Do not let them stand up suddenly.

donts: Do not give liquids immediately if the person is still confused or drowsy.
Do not ignore a head injury after fainting.

ro.summary: In convulsii, prioritatea este protectia persoanei si mentinerea cailor respiratorii libere dupa episod.
followUpQuestions: Convulsia s-a oprit sau continua acum?

immediateSteps.title: Protejeaza persoana de obiecte dure sau ascutite
immediateSteps.detail: Elibereaza zona din jur fara sa o imobilizezi fortat.

immediateSteps.title: Protejeaza capul
immediateSteps.detail: Pune ceva moale sub cap daca poti face asta in siguranta.

immediateSteps.title: Dupa ce se opreste, intoarce persoana pe o parte
immediateSteps.detail: Asta ajuta respiratia si scade riscul de aspiratie.

donts: Nu pune nimic in gura persoanei.
Nu o imobiliza cu forta in timpul convulsiei.

en.summary: During a seizure, the priority is protecting the person and keeping the airway safer after the episode.
followUpQuestions: Has the seizure stopped, or is it still happening now?

immediateSteps.title: Protect the person from hard or sharp objects
immediateSteps.detail: Clear the area without forcefully restraining them.

immediateSteps.title: Protect the head
immediateSteps.detail: Place something soft under the head if you can do it safely.

immediateSteps.title: When it stops, roll the person onto their side
immediateSteps.detail: This helps breathing and lowers aspiration risk.

donts: Do not put anything in the person?s mouth.
Do not hold them down during the seizure.

ro.summary: Reactia alergica poate deveni rapida si severa daca apare umflarea gatului sau dificultatea de respiratie.
followUpQuestions: Exista umflare la buze, limba, fata sau respiratie tot mai grea?

immediateSteps.title: Opreste contactul cu declansatorul daca este posibil
immediateSteps.detail: Indeparteaza alergenul sau muta persoana din zona respectiva.

immediateSteps.title: Daca are adrenalina autoinjectabila, foloseste-o conform instructiunilor
immediateSteps.detail: Fa asta imediat daca exista semne severe.

immediateSteps.title: Suna la 112 daca apar semne severe
immediateSteps.detail: Mai ales la respiratie grea, umflare rapida sau stare de lesin.

donts: Nu astepta sa treaca de la sine daca respiratia se agraveaza.
Nu lasa persoana singura daca simptomele cresc.

en.summary: An allergic reaction can become severe quickly if throat swelling or breathing difficulty appears.
followUpQuestions: Is there swelling of the lips, tongue, face, or increasingly difficult breathing?

immediateSteps.title: Stop contact with the trigger if possible
immediateSteps.detail: Remove the allergen or move the person away from it.

immediateSteps.title: If they have an epinephrine auto-injector, use it as directed
immediateSteps.detail: Do this immediately if severe signs are present.

immediateSteps.title: Call 112 if severe signs appear
immediateSteps.detail: Especially for breathing difficulty, rapid swelling or faintness.

donts: Do not wait for it to pass on its own if breathing worsens.
Do not leave the person alone while symptoms are increasing.

ro.summary: Prioritatea este sa limitezi miscarea si sa reduci agravarea durerii sau leziunii.
followUpQuestions: Exista deformare evidenta sau imposibilitate completa de sprijin?

immediateSteps.title: Nu forta miscarea
immediateSteps.detail: Opreste persoana sa sprijine greutatea pe zona ranita.

immediateSteps.title: Imobilizeaza membrul in pozitia gasita
immediateSteps.detail: Fara sa il indrepti fortat.

immediateSteps.title: Aplica rece printr-un material
immediateSteps.detail: Nu pune gheata direct pe piele.

donts: Nu incerca sa aliniezi osul.
Nu obliga persoana sa mearga daca durerea este mare.
call112Triggers: persoana nu se poate misca deloc

en.summary: The priority is limiting movement and preventing the injury or pain from getting worse.
followUpQuestions: Is there obvious deformity or complete inability to bear weight?

immediateSteps.title: Do not force movement
immediateSteps.detail: Stop the person from putting weight on the injured area.

immediateSteps.title: Immobilize the limb in the position found
immediateSteps.detail: Do not try to straighten it by force.

immediateSteps.title: Apply cold through a cloth
immediateSteps.detail: Do not place ice directly on the skin.

donts: Do not try to realign the bone.
Do not force the person to walk if pain is severe.

ro.summary: O fractura deschisa este o urgenta serioasa.
followUpQuestions: Sangerarea este puternica sau osul este expus vizibil?

immediateSteps.title: Suna la 112 imediat
immediateSteps.detail: Descrie clar ca osul este expus sau rana este severa.

immediateSteps.title: Acopera rana cu un material curat fara sa apesi pe os
immediateSteps.detail: Protejeaza zona de murdarire suplimentara.

immediateSteps.title: Imobilizeaza zona fara sa o fortezi
immediateSteps.detail: Miscarea brusca poate agrava leziunea si sangerarea.

donts: Nu impinge osul inapoi.
Nu spala agresiv rana.

en.summary: An open fracture is a serious emergency.
followUpQuestions: Is the bleeding heavy, or is the bone clearly exposed?

immediateSteps.title: Call 112 immediately
immediateSteps.detail: Say clearly that bone is exposed or the wound is severe.

immediateSteps.title: Cover the wound with a clean material without pressing on bone
immediateSteps.detail: Protect the area from more contamination.

immediateSteps.title: Immobilize the area without forcing it
immediateSteps.detail: Sudden movement can worsen injury and bleeding.

donts: Do not push the bone back in.
Do not scrub or aggressively wash the wound.

ro.summary: La lovitura la cap, urmareste semnele neurologice si evita miscarea inutila.
followUpQuestions: Exista varsaturi, somnolenta accentuata, confuzie sau pierdere de constienta?

immediateSteps.title: Tine persoana cat mai nemiscata
immediateSteps.detail: Mai ales daca exista si durere la gat sau dupa o cadere serioasa.

immediateSteps.title: Urmariti semnele de alarma
immediateSteps.detail: Confuzie, somnolenta, varsaturi, convulsii, inrautatire rapida.

immediateSteps.title: Poti aplica rece pe zona lovita printr-un material
immediateSteps.detail: Doar daca nu exista rana deschisa majora.

donts: Nu lasa persoana singura daca apar simptome neurologice.
Nu minimaliza o pierdere de constienta, chiar daca a fost scurta.

en.summary: With a head injury, watch for neurological signs and avoid unnecessary movement.
followUpQuestions: Is there vomiting, marked drowsiness, confusion or loss of consciousness?

immediateSteps.title: Keep the person as still as possible
immediateSteps.detail: Especially if there is neck pain or a serious fall.

immediateSteps.title: Watch for warning signs
immediateSteps.detail: Confusion, drowsiness, vomiting, seizures, or rapid worsening.

immediateSteps.title: You may apply cold through a cloth
immediateSteps.detail: Only if there is no major open wound.

donts: Do not leave the person alone if neurological symptoms appear.
Do not dismiss any loss of consciousness, even if brief.

ro.summary: Prioritatea este sa reduci rapid pierderea de sange.
followUpQuestions: Sangerarea scade sub presiune directa sau continua puternic?

immediateSteps.title: Suna la 112 imediat daca sangerarea este abundenta
immediateSteps.detail: Spune clar ca exista sangerare puternica.

immediateSteps.title: Apasa direct pe rana cu un material curat
immediateSteps.detail: Mentine presiune constanta.

immediateSteps.title: Daca materialul se imbiba, adauga altul peste
immediateSteps.detail: Nu indeparta primul strat.

immediateSteps.title: Tine persoana cat mai nemiscata si calda
immediateSteps.detail: Asta poate reduce agravarea starii de soc.

donts: Nu ridica mereu pansamentul ca sa verifici rana.
Nu intarzia apelul la 112 daca sangele curge puternic.

en.summary: The priority is to reduce blood loss quickly.
followUpQuestions: Is the bleeding slowing with direct pressure, or still coming out heavily?

immediateSteps.title: Call 112 immediately if bleeding is heavy
immediateSteps.detail: Say clearly there is severe bleeding.

immediateSteps.title: Press directly on the wound with a clean material
immediateSteps.detail: Keep steady pressure.

immediateSteps.title: If the material soaks through, add another layer on top
immediateSteps.detail: Do not remove the first layer.

immediateSteps.title: Keep the person still and warm
immediateSteps.detail: This can reduce worsening shock.

donts: Do not keep lifting the dressing to inspect the wound.
Do not delay calling 112 if blood is flowing heavily.

ro.summary: Prioritatea este sa eviti orice scanteie si sa evacuezi zona.
followUpQuestions: Esti deja afara in siguranta sau esti inca in zona cu miros de gaz?

immediateSteps.title: Nu aprinde nimic si nu folosi intrerupatoare
immediateSteps.detail: Evita orice scanteie, inclusiv lumini, prize sau brichete.

immediateSteps.title: Daca poti fara risc, deschide usi sau ferestre
immediateSteps.detail: Fa asta doar daca iesirea ramane imediata si sigura.

immediateSteps.title: Evacueaza imediat zona
immediateSteps.detail: Indeparteaza-te de cladire si avertizeaza rapid persoanele apropiate.

donts: Nu ramane inauntru ca sa investighezi.
Nu folosi telefonul in zona imediata daca suspectezi risc de aprindere.

en.summary: The priority is avoiding any spark and evacuating the area.
followUpQuestions: Are you already outside safely, or still in the area with the gas smell?

immediateSteps.title: Do not ignite anything or use switches
immediateSteps.detail: Avoid any spark, including lights, plugs or lighters.

immediateSteps.title: If you can do it safely, open doors or windows
immediateSteps.detail: Do this only if your exit remains immediate and safe.

immediateSteps.title: Evacuate the area immediately
immediateSteps.detail: Move away from the building and quickly warn nearby people.

donts: Do not stay inside to investigate.
Do not use your phone in the immediate danger area if you suspect ignition risk.

ro.summary: La intoxicatie, prioritatea este sa opresti expunerea si sa eviti actiuni care pot agrava cazul.
followUpQuestions: A inghitit ceva, a inhalat fum sau gaze, sau a avut contact pe piele?

immediateSteps.title: Opreste expunerea daca este sigur
immediateSteps.detail: Scoate persoana din zona toxica sau indeparteaza substanta de pe piele.

immediateSteps.title: Pastreaza recipientul sau numele substantei daca il ai
immediateSteps.detail: Informatiile ajuta echipajele si dispeceratul.

immediateSteps.title: Suna la 112 daca persoana este somnolenta, confuza, se sufoca sau respira greu
immediateSteps.detail: Urgenta creste rapid in aceste cazuri.

donts: Nu provoca varsaturi decat daca specialistii iti spun clar asta.
Nu da lapte sau alte lichide la intamplare.

en.summary: In poisoning, the priority is stopping exposure and avoiding actions that may worsen the case.
followUpQuestions: Did the person swallow something, inhale smoke or gas, or get a substance on the skin?

immediateSteps.title: Stop the exposure if it is safe
immediateSteps.detail: Move the person away from the toxic area or remove the substance from the skin.

immediateSteps.title: Keep the container or substance name if available
immediateSteps.detail: That information helps emergency teams and dispatch.

immediateSteps.title: Call 112 if the person is drowsy, confused, choking or breathing hard
immediateSteps.detail: Urgency rises quickly in these cases.

donts: Do not induce vomiting unless a specialist clearly tells you to do so.
Do not give milk or other liquids blindly.

ro.summary: Blocarea in lift devine urgenta mai ales daca apare fum, lipsa de aer, boala acuta sau panica severa.
followUpQuestions: Liftul este blocat simplu sau exista fum, miros de ars ori cineva se simte rau?

immediateSteps.title: Foloseste butonul de alarma sau interfonul
immediateSteps.detail: Anunta clar etajul aproximativ si numarul de persoane.

immediateSteps.title: Ramai calm si stai departe de usi
immediateSteps.detail: Evita sa fortezi iesirea intre etaje.

immediateSteps.title: Suna la 112 daca exista fum, lipsa de aer sau o urgenta medicala
immediateSteps.detail: Aceste semne schimba cazul intr-o urgenta reala.

donts: Nu forta usile cu mainile sau obiecte.
Nu incerca sa iesi intre etaje.

en.summary: Being trapped in an elevator becomes urgent especially if there is smoke, lack of air, acute illness or severe panic.
followUpQuestions: Is it a simple elevator stoppage, or is there smoke, a burning smell or someone feeling seriously ill?

immediateSteps.title: Use the alarm button or intercom
immediateSteps.detail: Clearly report the approximate floor and number of people.

immediateSteps.title: Stay calm and keep away from the doors
immediateSteps.detail: Do not try to force your way out between floors.

immediateSteps.title: Call 112 if there is smoke, lack of air or a medical emergency
immediateSteps.detail: Those signs turn the case into a true emergency.

donts: Do not force the doors with your hands or objects.
Do not try to climb out between floors.

ro.summary: Intr-o situatie periculoasa provocata de alta persoana, prioritatea este sa iesi din zona si sa suni la 112 daca amenintarea este imediata.
followUpQuestions: Agresorul este inca aproape sau ai reusit sa ajungi intr-un loc sigur?

immediateSteps.title: Iesi imediat din zona daca exista o ruta sigura
immediateSteps.detail: Mergi spre un loc populat, iluminat sau securizat.

immediateSteps.title: Suna la 112 daca pericolul este imediat
immediateSteps.detail: Spune locatia, descrierea agresorului si daca exista arme.

immediateSteps.title: Cauta martori sau personal de securitate
immediateSteps.detail: Prezenta altor persoane poate reduce riscul imediat.

donts: Nu te intoarce in zona periculoasa pentru obiecte.
Nu ramane singur intr-un loc izolat daca amenintarea continua.

en.summary: In a dangerous situation caused by another person, the priority is leaving the area and calling 112 if the threat is immediate.
followUpQuestions: Is the attacker still close, or have you reached a safer place?

immediateSteps.title: Leave the area immediately if there is a safe route
immediateSteps.detail: Move toward a populated, lit or secure place.

immediateSteps.title: Call 112 if the danger is immediate
immediateSteps.detail: Give your location, the attacker description and whether there are weapons.

immediateSteps.title: Look for witnesses or security staff
immediateSteps.detail: Other people nearby can reduce the immediate risk.

donts: Do not go back into the dangerous area for belongings.
Do not stay alone in an isolated place if the threat continues.

ro.summary: Un copil inconstient este o urgenta severa. Prioritatea este respiratia si apelul rapid la 112.
followUpQuestions: Copilul respira normal in acest moment?

immediateSteps.title: Suna la 112 imediat
immediateSteps.detail: Spune clar ca este vorba despre un copil inconstient.

immediateSteps.title: Verifica rapid daca respira
immediateSteps.detail: Priveste toracele si asculta respiratia cateva secunde.

immediateSteps.title: Daca respira, pune copilul pe o parte cu grija
immediateSteps.detail: Pozitia laterala ajuta mentinerea cailor respiratorii libere.

donts: Nu lasa copilul nesupravegheat.
Nu presupune ca isi revine rapid fara ajutor.

en.summary: An unconscious child is a severe emergency. The priority is breathing and a fast 112 call.
followUpQuestions: Is the child breathing normally right now?

immediateSteps.title: Call 112 immediately
immediateSteps.detail: Say clearly that this is an unconscious child.

immediateSteps.title: Quickly check if the child is breathing
immediateSteps.detail: Look at the chest and listen for breathing for a few seconds.

immediateSteps.title: If breathing, place the child on their side carefully
immediateSteps.detail: The recovery position helps keep the airway open.

donts: Do not leave the child unattended.
Do not assume the child will recover quickly without help.

ro.summary: Persoana inconstienta poate intra rapid in risc vital.
followUpQuestions: Persoana respira normal chiar acum?

immediateSteps.title: Suna la 112 imediat
immediateSteps.detail: Spune ca persoana nu raspunde.

immediateSteps.title: Verifica respiratia si raspunsul
immediateSteps.detail: Daca nu respira normal, urmeaza imediat instructiunile de resuscitare.

immediateSteps.title: Daca respira, pune-o in pozitia laterala de siguranta
immediateSteps.detail: Asta ajuta mentinerea cailor respiratorii libere.

donts: Nu lasa persoana singura.
Nu ii da lichide sau medicamente cat timp este inconstienta.

en.summary: An unconscious adult can deteriorate into immediate life-threatening danger.
followUpQuestions: Is the person breathing normally right now?

immediateSteps.title: Call 112 immediately
immediateSteps.detail: Say the person is not responding.

immediateSteps.title: Check breathing and responsiveness
immediateSteps.detail: If they are not breathing normally, follow resuscitation instructions immediately.

immediateSteps.title: If they are breathing, place them in the recovery position
immediateSteps.detail: This helps keep the airway open.

donts: Do not leave the person alone.
Do not give food, drink or medication while they are unconscious.

ro.summary: Te ajut cu pasi scurti pana clarificam urgenta.
followUpQuestions: Este vorba despre foc, respiratie, sangerare, cadere sau alta amenintare imediata?

immediateSteps.title: Muta-te intr-o zona sigura
immediateSteps.detail: Indeparteaza-te de foc, trafic, curent electric sau obiecte care pot cadea.

immediateSteps.title: Daca exista pericol vital, suna la 112
immediateSteps.detail: Nu astepta clarificari suplimentare daca viata este in pericol.

immediateSteps.title: Observa cele mai grave semne
immediateSteps.detail: Respiratia, sangerarea, constienta si posibilitatea de evacuare sunt primele lucruri de verificat.

donts: Nu intra in actiuni riscante fara o iesire clara.
Nu ignora semnele vitale grave.

en.summary: I will help with short steps until we clarify the emergency.
followUpQuestions: Is this about fire, breathing, bleeding, a fall, or another immediate threat?

immediateSteps.title: Move to a safer area
immediateSteps.detail: Get away from fire, traffic, electricity or falling objects.

immediateSteps.title: If there is life-threatening danger, call 112
immediateSteps.detail: Do not wait for more clarification if life is at risk.

immediateSteps.title: Look for the most severe signs
immediateSteps.detail: Breathing, bleeding, consciousness and the ability to evacuate are the first things to check.

donts: Do not take risky actions without a clear way out.
Do not ignore severe vital warning signs.

ro.summary: Acesta pare un mesaj non-critic, deci pot raspunde mai liber.
followUpQuestions: Vrei informatii de preventie, pregatire sau explicatii despre un scenariu anume?

immediateSteps.title: Cererea este tratata ca intrebare generala
immediateSteps.detail: Se poate folosi modelul pentru explicatii mai largi, dar se pastreaza regulile de ton si siguranta.

donts: Nu transforma automat o intrebare generala intr-o urgenta critica fara semnale clare.

en.summary: This looks like a non-critical message, so I can answer more freely.
followUpQuestions: Do you want prevention, preparedness or an explanation about a specific scenario?

immediateSteps.title: The request is treated as a general question
immediateSteps.detail: The model can be used for broader explanations, while keeping tone and safety guardrails.

donts: Do not automatically turn a general question into a critical emergency without clear signals.

ro.summary: La arsura, prioritatea este oprirea sursei si racirea zonei fara a agrava rana.
followUpQuestions: Arsura este mare, pe fata, pe gat, pe maini, pe organele genitale sau pare profunda?

immediateSteps.title: Opreste sursa de arsura
immediateSteps.detail: Indeparteaza persoana de foc, lichid fierbinte, abur sau curent daca poti face asta in siguranta.

immediateSteps.title: Raceste zona cu apa rece, nu cu gheata
immediateSteps.detail: Tine arsura sub apa rece cateva minute daca nu exista risc suplimentar.

immediateSteps.title: Acopera lejer cu un material curat neaderent
immediateSteps.detail: Protejeaza zona fara sa freci sau sa spargi basicile.

donts: Nu pune gheata direct pe piele.
Nu sparge basicile.
Nu aplica ulei, pasta de dinti sau creme improvizate pe arsuri severe.

en.summary: For burns, the priority is to stop the source and cool the area without worsening the injury.
followUpQuestions: Is the burn large, on the face, neck, hands, genitals, or does it look deep?

immediateSteps.title: Stop the source of the burn
immediateSteps.detail: Move the person away from fire, hot liquid, steam or electricity if you can do so safely.

immediateSteps.title: Cool the area with cool water, not ice
immediateSteps.detail: Run cool water over the burn for several minutes if there is no added danger.

immediateSteps.title: Cover loosely with a clean non-stick material
immediateSteps.detail: Protect the area without rubbing it or breaking blisters.

donts: Do not place ice directly on the skin.
Do not break blisters.
Do not apply oil, toothpaste or improvised creams to severe burns.

ro.summary: La aproape inec sau inec, prioritatea este scoaterea din pericol si verificarea respiratiei.
followUpQuestions: Persoana respira normal sau tuseste, gafaie ori nu raspunde?

immediateSteps.title: Scoate persoana din apa doar daca poti fara sa te pui in pericol
immediateSteps.detail: Evita sa devii a doua victima.

immediateSteps.title: Verifica imediat respiratia si raspunsul
immediateSteps.detail: Daca nu respira normal, suna la 112 si urmeaza instructiunile primite.

immediateSteps.title: Tine persoana la cald si sub observatie continua
immediateSteps.detail: Chiar daca vorbeste, starea se poate agrava dupa aspirarea apei.

donts: Nu pierde timp incercand sa scoti apa din plamani prin manevre improvizate.
Nu presupune ca este in regula doar pentru ca a inceput sa vorbeasca.

en.summary: For drowning or near drowning, the priority is to remove the person from danger and check breathing right away.
followUpQuestions: Is the person breathing normally, or coughing, gasping, or unresponsive?

immediateSteps.title: Remove the person from the water only if you can do it safely
immediateSteps.detail: Avoid becoming a second victim.

immediateSteps.title: Check breathing and responsiveness immediately
immediateSteps.detail: If they are not breathing normally, call 112 and follow instructions right away.

immediateSteps.title: Keep the person warm and under close observation
immediateSteps.detail: Even if they can speak, their condition can worsen after water aspiration.

donts: Do not waste time trying to drain water from the lungs with improvised actions.
Do not assume everything is fine just because the person started talking.

ro.summary: La posibil AVC, mai ales la varstnic, prioritatea este apelul rapid la 112 si notarea orei de debut.
followUpQuestions: Are fata cazuta, vorbeste neclar sau nu poate ridica un brat?

immediateSteps.title: Suna la 112 imediat
immediateSteps.detail: Spune clar ca suspectezi un AVC sau o slabiciune brusca severa.

immediateSteps.title: Noteaza cand a inceput simptomul
immediateSteps.detail: Ora debutului este importanta pentru echipajele medicale.

immediateSteps.title: Tine persoana asezata sau culcata in siguranta
immediateSteps.detail: Monitorizeaza vorbirea, respiratia si nivelul de constienta.

donts: Nu da mancare, bautura sau medicamente la intamplare.
Nu astepta sa treaca daca simptomele au aparut brusc.

en.summary: For a possible stroke, especially in an elderly person, the priority is to call 112 quickly and note the time symptoms started.
followUpQuestions: Is there facial droop, slurred speech, or weakness in one arm?

immediateSteps.title: Call 112 immediately
immediateSteps.detail: Say clearly that you suspect a stroke or sudden severe weakness.

immediateSteps.title: Note when the symptom started
immediateSteps.detail: The symptom onset time matters for the medical team.

immediateSteps.title: Keep the person seated or lying safely
immediateSteps.detail: Monitor speech, breathing and level of consciousness.

donts: Do not give food, drink or random medication.
Do not wait for symptoms to pass if they started suddenly.

ro.summary: La copil care respira greu, trierea trebuie sa fie mai prudenta si mai rapida.
followUpQuestions: Copilul are buze vine?ii, nu poate plange normal sau se vede ca trage tare aer?

immediateSteps.title: Suna la 112 daca respiratia este dificila sau copilul devine moale
immediateSteps.detail: Mentioneaza clar ca este vorba despre copil sau sugar.

immediateSteps.title: Tine copilul intr-o pozitie care il ajuta sa respire
immediateSteps.detail: Nu il forta sa stea culcat daca se simte mai rau asa.

immediateSteps.title: Urmareste continuu culoarea pielii si nivelul de reactie
immediateSteps.detail: Agravarile rapide necesita escaladare imediata.

donts: Nu astepta prea mult la sugar sau copil mic cu respiratie grea.
Nu da lichide daca se sufoca sau este foarte somnolent.

en.summary: For a child with breathing difficulty, triage must be faster and more cautious.
followUpQuestions: Does the child have blue lips, cannot cry normally, or seem to struggle for air?

immediateSteps.title: Call 112 if breathing is difficult or the child becomes limp
immediateSteps.detail: State clearly that the patient is a child or infant.

immediateSteps.title: Keep the child in a position that helps breathing
immediateSteps.detail: Do not force them to lie flat if that makes breathing worse.

immediateSteps.title: Watch skin color and responsiveness continuously
immediateSteps.detail: Fast deterioration means immediate escalation.

donts: Do not wait too long with an infant or small child who is breathing poorly.
Do not give liquids if the child is choking or very drowsy.

ro.summary: Copilul cu febra mare si convulsii are nevoie de triere rapida si protectie imediata.
followUpQuestions: Convulsia continua acum sau copilul respira normal dupa episod?

immediateSteps.title: Protejeaza copilul de lovituri si elibereaza zona din jur
immediateSteps.detail: Nu il imobiliza fortat si nu pune nimic in gura.

immediateSteps.title: Dupa episod, pune copilul pe o parte daca respira
immediateSteps.detail: Pozitia laterala ajuta mentinerea cailor respiratorii libere.

immediateSteps.title: Suna la 112 daca episodul nu se opreste rapid, este primul sau copilul nu isi revine
immediateSteps.detail: Mentioneaza febra si varsta copilului.

donts: Nu pune obiecte in gura copilului.
Nu incerca sa opresti convulsia tinand copilul cu forta.

en.summary: A child with high fever and seizures needs fast triage and immediate protection.
followUpQuestions: Is the seizure still happening, or is the child breathing normally after it stopped?

immediateSteps.title: Protect the child from injury and clear the area
immediateSteps.detail: Do not hold them down and do not put anything in the mouth.

immediateSteps.title: After the seizure, place the child on their side if breathing
immediateSteps.detail: The recovery position helps keep the airway open.

immediateSteps.title: Call 112 if the episode does not stop quickly, is the first one, or the child does not recover
immediateSteps.detail: Mention the fever and the child?s age.

donts: Do not put objects in the child?s mouth.
Do not try to stop the seizure by holding the child down.

ro.summary: Daca exista intrus sau tentativa de intrare fortata, prioritatea este ascunderea sau iesirea sigura si apelul la 112.
followUpQuestions: Intrusul este deja in casa sau incearca sa intre?

immediateSteps.title: Baricadeaza sau blocheaza usa daca poti fara risc
immediateSteps.detail: Mentine distanta fata de zona de acces a agresorului.

immediateSteps.title: Ascunde-te sau iesi pe o ruta sigura daca exista
immediateSteps.detail: Alege varianta cu cel mai mic risc imediat.

immediateSteps.title: Suna la 112 imediat
immediateSteps.detail: Spune ca exista intrus, tentativa de spargere sau amenintare in casa.

donts: Nu deschide usa ca sa confrunti persoana.
Nu ramane in fata intrarii daca poti merge intr-un loc mai sigur.

en.summary: If there is an intruder or forced entry attempt, the priority is to hide or leave safely and call 112.
followUpQuestions: Is the intruder already inside, or trying to get in?

immediateSteps.title: Barricade or lock the door if you can do it safely
immediateSteps.detail: Keep distance from the access point.

immediateSteps.title: Hide or leave through a safe route if one exists
immediateSteps.detail: Choose the option with the lowest immediate risk.

immediateSteps.title: Call 112 immediately
immediateSteps.detail: Say there is an intruder, break-in attempt or direct threat inside the home.

donts: Do not open the door to confront the person.
Do not stay by the entrance if you can move somewhere safer.

ro.summary: La violenta domestica sau control coercitiv cu pericol imediat, prioritatea este siguranta fizica si apelul rapid la 112.
followUpQuestions: Agresorul este langa tine chiar acum sau poti vorbi dintr-un loc sigur?

immediateSteps.title: Mergi intr-un loc din care poti iesi usor sau te poti incuia
immediateSteps.detail: Evita bucataria, baia si camerele cu obiecte periculoase daca poti.

immediateSteps.title: Suna la 112 daca exista amenintare imediata sau violenta
immediateSteps.detail: Daca nu poti vorbi liber, trimite cat mai putine informatii esentiale.

immediateSteps.title: Cauta sprijin imediat de la o persoana de incredere dupa ce esti in siguranta
immediateSteps.detail: Prioritatea ramane iesirea din pericolul imediat.

donts: Nu anunta agresorul ca incerci sa ceri ajutor daca asta creste riscul.
Nu ramane intr-o camera fara iesire usoara daca poti evita asta.

en.summary: In domestic violence or coercive control with immediate danger, the priority is physical safety and a fast call to 112.
followUpQuestions: Is the aggressor next to you right now, or can you speak from a safe place?

immediateSteps.title: Move to a place you can lock or leave easily
immediateSteps.detail: Avoid kitchens, bathrooms and rooms with dangerous objects if possible.

immediateSteps.title: Call 112 if there is immediate threat or violence
immediateSteps.detail: If you cannot speak freely, send only the most essential information.

immediateSteps.title: Reach a trusted person as soon as you are safe
immediateSteps.detail: The first priority remains getting out of immediate danger.

donts: Do not warn the aggressor that you are asking for help if that raises risk.
Do not stay in a room without an easy exit if you can avoid it.

ro.summary: La suspiciune de monoxid de carbon, prioritatea este evacuarea rapida si aerul curat.
followUpQuestions: Mai multe persoane au durere de cap, ameteli, greata sau somnolenta in acelasi loc?

immediateSteps.title: Iesi imediat la aer curat
immediateSteps.detail: Scoate si celelalte persoane daca poti fara sa te expui inutil.

immediateSteps.title: Suna la 112 daca exista simptome sau cineva e confuz ori somnolent
immediateSteps.detail: Mentioneaza posibil monoxid de carbon, soba, centrala sau generator.

immediateSteps.title: Nu reintra in spatiu pana nu este declarat sigur
immediateSteps.detail: Pericolul poate persista fara miros clar.

donts: Nu presupune ca este doar oboseala daca mai multe persoane se simt rau in acelasi loc.
Nu reintra sa verifici sursa daca deja ai simptome.

en.summary: For suspected carbon monoxide exposure, the priority is quick evacuation and fresh air.
followUpQuestions: Do multiple people in the same place have headache, dizziness, nausea or unusual drowsiness?

immediateSteps.title: Move out to fresh air immediately
immediateSteps.detail: Take other people out too if you can do it without unnecessary exposure.

immediateSteps.title: Call 112 if there are symptoms or anyone is confused or drowsy
immediateSteps.detail: Mention possible carbon monoxide, heater, boiler or generator exposure.

immediateSteps.title: Do not go back inside until the area is declared safe
immediateSteps.detail: The danger can persist even without a strong smell.

donts: Do not assume it is just fatigue if several people feel ill in the same place.
Do not go back in to inspect the source if you already have symptoms.

trainingExamples.notes: Elderly fainting needs closer follow-up.

trainingExamples.input: mama a cazut si cred ca si a rupt soldul
trainingExamples.idealOutput: Nu o forta sa se ridice si nu o misca inutil. Tine-o cat mai nemiscata si suna la 112 daca durerea este mare sau nu poate deloc sa se miste. Poate misca piciorul?
trainingExamples.expectedFollowUp: Poate misca piciorul?
trainingExamples.notes: Cadere la varstnic cu posibil sold fracturat.

trainingExamples.input: my mother fell and i think she broke her hip
trainingExamples.idealOutput: Do not force her to stand and do not move her unnecessarily. Keep her as still as possible and call 112 if pain is severe or she cannot move at all. Can she move the leg?
trainingExamples.expectedFollowUp: Can she move the leg?
trainingExamples.notes: Possible hip fracture after fall.

trainingExamples.notes: Arsurile pe fata si gat cresc riscul de afectare a cailor respiratorii.

trainingExamples.input: i burned my face and neck with steam
trainingExamples.idealOutput: Call 112 now. Move away from the source and cool the area gently with cool water, not ice. Are you breathing normally, or is there throat irritation too?
trainingExamples.expectedFollowUp: Are you breathing normally, or is there throat irritation too?
trainingExamples.notes: Face and neck burns can threaten the airway.

trainingExamples.input: a iesit din apa si zice ca e bine dar tuseste rau
trainingExamples.idealOutput: Suna la 112 daca tusea continua sau respiratia se agraveaza. Tine persoana la cald si sub observatie continua. Respira mai greu decat la inceput?
trainingExamples.expectedFollowUp: Respira mai greu decat la inceput?
trainingExamples.notes: Aproape inec cu aparenta revenire, dar cu risc ulterior.

trainingExamples.input: he got out of the water and says hes fine but keeps coughing hard
trainingExamples.idealOutput: Call 112 if the coughing continues or breathing worsens. Keep the person warm and under close observation. Is breathing harder than it was at first?
trainingExamples.expectedFollowUp: Is breathing getting harder?
trainingExamples.notes: Post-submersion symptoms can worsen after initial recovery.

trainingExamples.input: ajut

trainingExamples.expectedFollowUp: Este foc, respiratie, sangerare sau agresor?
trainingExamples.notes: Input de un cuvant care trebuie sa produca raspuns util, nu blocaj.

trainingExamples.input: help
trainingExamples.idealOutput: Breathe slowly. Move to a safer place and tell me the most urgent danger: fire, breathing, bleeding or attacker?
trainingExamples.expectedFollowUp: Is it fire, breathing, bleeding or an attacker?
trainingExamples.notes: Single-word distress input must not block the system.

trainingExamples.input: e rau
trainingExamples.idealOutput: Spune mai intai ce e cel mai grav acum: nu respira, sangereaza, e inconstient sau exista foc ori gaz? Daca este pericol vital, suna la 112 imediat.
trainingExamples.expectedFollowUp: Nu respira, sangereaza, e inconstient sau exista foc ori gaz?
trainingExamples.notes: Input vag si comun.

trainingExamples.input: its bad
trainingExamples.idealOutput: Tell me the worst sign first: not breathing, bleeding, unconscious, or fire or gas? If there is life-threatening danger, call 112 immediately.
trainingExamples.expectedFollowUp: Not breathing, bleeding, unconscious, or fire or gas?
trainingExamples.notes: Very vague but common distress input.

trainingExamples.input: om in casa
trainingExamples.idealOutput: Ascunde-te sau blocheaza usa daca poti si suna la 112 imediat. Intrusul este in aceeasi camera cu tine?
trainingExamples.expectedFollowUp: Intrusul este in aceeasi camera cu tine?
trainingExamples.notes: Input de doua cuvinte pentru pericol extrem.

trainingExamples.input: man in house
trainingExamples.idealOutput: Hide or barricade yourself if you can and call 112 immediately. Is the intruder in the same room as you?
trainingExamples.expectedFollowUp: Is the intruder in the same room as you?
trainingExamples.notes: Two-word extreme danger input.

trainingExamples.input: sunt atacat pe strada
trainingExamples.idealOutput: Mergi spre oameni sau un magazin deschis si suna la 112 acum daca agresorul este inca langa tine. Poti ajunge intr-un loc luminat imediat?
trainingExamples.expectedFollowUp: Poti ajunge intr-un loc luminat imediat?
trainingExamples.notes: Atac fizic direct in spatiu public.

trainingExamples.input: im being attacked on the street
trainingExamples.idealOutput: Move toward people or an open shop and call 112 now if the attacker is still near you. Can you reach a lit place immediately?
trainingExamples.expectedFollowUp: Can you reach a lit place immediately?
trainingExamples.notes: Direct public attack.

trainingExamples.input: a inhalat fum toxic si e ametit
trainingExamples.idealOutput: Scoate persoana la aer curat si suna la 112 daca ametelile, confuzia sau respiratia grea continua. Poate vorbi clar?
trainingExamples.expectedFollowUp: Poate vorbi clar?
trainingExamples.notes: Expunere prin inhalare, nu prin ingestie.

trainingExamples.expectedFollowUp: Can he speak clearly?
trainingExamples.notes: Inhalation exposure rather than swallowing.

trainingExamples.notes: Intrebare legitima de preventie, fara semne de urgenta reala.

trainingExamples.notes: Preparedness question, not an active emergency.

trainingExamples.idealOutput: Acesta este un mesaj informativ, dar trebuie mentionate clar semnele de alarma precum durerea puternica in piept, iradierea in brat sau maxilar, transpiratiile reci si lesinul.
trainingExamples.notes: Non-emergency informational question that still needs safe distinctions.

trainingExamples.idealOutput: This is an informational question, but it still needs clear warning signs such as strong chest pain, pain spreading to the arm or jaw, cold sweating and fainting.
trainingExamples.notes: Educational question with safety relevance.

nonEmergencyHandling.systemPromptIntent: For non-emergency communication questions, the model may answer more freely but must stay concise, calm, practical and consistent with the knowledge base.

fallbackResponse.ro: Mesajul pare non-critic. Pot raspunde mai liber despre pregatire, preventie sau explicatii practice. Spune exact ce vrei sa afli.
fallbackResponse.en: This looks non-critical. I can answer more freely about preparedness, prevention or practical explanations. Tell me exactly what you want to know.

ro: Daca mesajul mentioneaza respiratie, sangerare, inconstienta, foc, gaz, agresor sau copil foarte mic bolnav, nu il trata ca simpla intrebare generala.
Daca intentia este ambigua intre preventie si urgenta, raspunde mai intai cu pasi siguri si o intrebare scurta de clarificare.
en: If the message mentions breathing, bleeding, unresponsiveness, fire, gas, an attacker or a very young sick child, do not treat it as a simple general question.
If intent is ambiguous between preparedness and emergency, answer with safe first steps and one short clarification question.
